question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**influence**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses how orbital cycles affect the amount of energy Earth receives from the sun.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate an effect or impact on the energy received.
 
• '**Influence**' fits well as it denotes having an effect on, which aligns with the context of the passage.
 
• Other options ('**stretch**', '**return**', '**believe**') do not fit the context of describing the effect of orbital cycles.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The fact that the wetter periods in North Africa have recurred__ every 21,000 years or so is a big clue about what *__*causes*__* them: variations in Earth’s orbit. Due to gravitational influences from the moon and other planets in our solar system, the orbit of the Earth **__around__ the sun is not constant. It has cyclic **__variations__ on multi-thousand year timescales. These orbital cycles **__influence__** the amount of energy the Earth receives from the sun. On 100,000-year cycles, the shape of Earth’s orbit shifts between circular and oval.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Stretch (खींचना): "Stretch" means to extend or elongate, which does not fit the context of describing the effect on energy.
 
• Return (वापसी): "Return" means to go back to a place or person, which does not reflect the idea of influencing energy.
 
• Believe (विश्वास करना): "Believe" means to accept something as true, which does not align with describing the effect of orbital cycles on energy.
